candidateAssessment.whyItIsSmallest: It is a static CLI check on the already-public self-improvement research-register owner. The existing ResearchComponentComparisonV2/V3 family and ResearchDocumentOverlayV1 seam can exercise decision presence, required requirement IDs, primary-evidence links, option support/tradeoffs, unresolved-fact handling, and validation AT IDs without native/device/account work or a real research send.
candidateAssessment.reason: The current evidence object has only id, url, publisher, kind, and supportedOptionIds. No canonical field records the primary source version or maps a required requirement ID to an exact source quote/locator. The overlay digest binds fixture report bytes, not the cited primary source. Existing specReferences.requirementMappingRows are source-line/requirement-cell inventory data and do not connect quote text to a primary evidence item. Therefore a V2/V3-shaped synthetic decision cannot falsifiably prove AT-lifestore-45's versioned-primary and requirement/quote clauses.
candidateAssessment.decision: Do not add a generic comparison-probe clone and label it AT-lifestore-45. The assigned whole assertion remains source-execution-blocked until the research-register owner has a versioned quote-to-requirement representation and check. AT-lifestore-47 and AT-lifestore-70 are not substitutes for this gap.

currentPublicBoundary.existingInterface: EngineeringControl.checkResearch(input: MapCheckInputV1, context: OpsControlContextV1, testDocuments?: readonly ResearchDocumentOverlayV1[]): Result<ResearchRegisterInspectionV3>
currentPublicBoundary.reportOverlay: ResearchDocumentOverlayV1 binds reportKey, originalDigest, contentDigest, and markdown to an indexed report while using the owned test stack.
currentPublicBoundary.existingChecks: compareDecision derives expected requirement IDs; checks selected proven option, primary evidence linkage, option tradeoffs, exact release gate, nonempty validation IDs linked to indexed AT IDs, and selected-option unresolved facts. Inspection hard-codes admission BLOCKED, acceptanceComplete false, wholeATsPassed empty, and researchAttestationVerified false.
currentPublicBoundary.existingProbeOwner: packages/self-improvement/src/component-comparison-probe.ts; public dispatch is packages/self-improvement/src/public.ts. Current assigned manifest patterns include AT-self-improvement-54 and AT-sources-188/190, but not AT-lifestore-45.

minimumConcreteOwnerPrerequisite.owner: self-improvement research-register owner; canonical contracts owner decides the additive report version and generated integration
minimumConcreteOwnerPrerequisite.whyNeeded: Current V2/V3 are strict schemas and cannot carry or validate the exact assertion's versioned-primary source plus requirement-to-quote linkage.
minimalFalsifiableShape: A new versioned report shape (do not silently change strict V2/V3) must record an immutable source version and source digest for each primary evidence item.
The decision must carry a requirementQuoteMappings collection with requirementId, evidenceId, exact quote text, and stable source locator.

The owner check must require every expected mapped requirement ID to have at least one quote mapping to a primary, versioned, digest-bound evidence item; missing, secondary, unversioned, or dangling mappings must block and report the exact missing IDs. Existing validation.testIds must continue to resolve to indexed AT IDs.

A structurally complete seeded fixture can prove comparator behavior only. It does not authenticate the external source or establish that a quote is true; actual primary-source verification and the R0.02 research closure stay separate prerequisites.

skills/toy-control/FEATURE-MAP.md: revise the existing behavior.lifestore row from 'future assigned-rung owner route' to the actual research-register owner/CLI path once implemented. The acceptance index already contains the exact AT assertion and should not be hand-edited.
minimumConcreteOwnerPrerequisite.unresolvedOwnerDecision: The contract version is unresolved in this read-only plan. This is an internal design/integration decision for the canonical contract owner, not a user-permission gate. Once that owner chooses a compatible version, otherwise-authorized source work can proceed. Until then, do not implement an AT-lifestore-45 probe using current DTOs and do not claim the assignment advanced.

whyOtherCandidatesAreDeferred.AT-lifestore-47: Although V3 carries executionReceipt and the comparator checks observed research role/model/effort/tier and pinned skill metadata, this assignment also requires real stack/device-account route evidence. A synthetic or fixed receipt is not an accepted protected route, and this task must not fabricate one. Defer until the actual authorized route and skill loading evidence are available at the assigned CLI rung.
whyOtherCandidatesAreDeferred.AT-lifestore-70: This assertion selects release-tagged build scope under failed inference/resource/native/capture prerequisites. It belongs to release/build-scope admission, not the component-comparison owner. Its assigned static CLI source/manifest and the real prerequisite inventory are not established by the bounded comparison-owner inspection; leave it for the release owner rather than route it through a research report probe.
